newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound strengthens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound strengthens against the dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound strengthened against the dollar on Sunday in a private sector market long on the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"The market is very liquid and no one wants dollars," one banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3900 and 3.3910 bid and 3.3910 and 3.3930 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate was 3.39075 bid and 3.392375 offered compared to 3.396039 pounds bid and 3.397536 pounds offered on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.388331 pounds buy and 3.392878 pounds sell.
